items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And he even let me off to go to Russia with Thad and Mel

ctx.x: And behind that, that December when the Waldorf closed for the winter, when it came back to February, the Charlie Terry combo called me to be in the house band. He said, "I want you to play in the house band," he

said, "because a lot of the guys don't want to play the dance music." And I said, "I don't mind. Sure I'll play." And I played in the house band then up until September '73 when the Charlie Terry combo went out. And he even let me off to go to Russia with Thad and Mel and I came back and still had my job.
